scope: Re-order Rosters: initial ten-function core, not the full call graph

functions.name: Normalize team
functions.basis: All five blocks represented by signed int16 input/return, team-29 branch, mode-2 branch, signed context-byte promotion, and fallback team 3. Verified against recomp and Ghidra; native boundary tests. Not binary equivalence.

functions.name: Enter Re-order
functions.pending: Normalize team then construct shared lists of kinds 1 and 2; bind both callbacks and propagate result.

functions.name: Construct/run two-list screen
functions.pending: Private Z2PORT assets, 535-slot working snapshot, list construction/scrolling, callbacks and teardown; inspect callees before claiming this owner.

functions.name: First-list input
functions.basis: Existing 0x80056948 selected-ID/-1 test is reached via nba97_reorder_input. Six additional blocks (9+3+5+2+2+2=23 instructions) are represented by the first callback's typed context/input, exact 0x10/0x40/0x800 comparisons, preservation of the latch for View/Compare requests, and latch clear for other masks. All 65536 masks are tested, including combined values. Native context/arguments replace MIPS frame/register operations. View/Compare return explicit unconsumed requests; the actual FUN_80054B94 call block 0x80056914 is NOT credited. No modal, animation, or epilogue credit added.
functions.pending: Actual View/Compare availability/child dispatch (FUN_80054B94), state-12 empty-slot modal, begin-selection animation and epilogue remain pending. Local font-backed label diagnostics are tested but do not count as the complete original screen.

functions.name: Second-list input
functions.basis: Previously credited state-2 bypass and failed-validation latch clear remain represented through nba97_reorder_input. Six added dispatch blocks (10+3+5+2+2+2=24 instructions) map context/input and exact 0x10/0x40/0x800 checks to typed native arguments, preserve the latch for View/Compare and clear it for other masks. 0x80056A7C adds six native ABI replacement instructions: compiler-managed return to the caller replaces saved-register/frame restoration. Tests verify observable caller data/return results, not original MIPS register identities. Every mask is tested in both normal and synthesized-cancel states; every object-state byte is tested. Child requests remain explicit and unconsumed. No credit for unresolved calls or visual effects.
functions.pending: Five blocks (19 instructions): FUN_80054B94 View/Compare availability/dispatch call; shared validation/result handling; swap plus original row refresh; post-validation continuation branch; finish-selection animation call. They remain uncredited despite the working Re-order-only state paths.

functions.name: Begin second selection
functions.pending: Focus/state transition is implemented; the single original block also calls highlight animation and display refresh, which remain pending, so no whole-block credit.

functions.name: Finish/cancel second selection
functions.pending: First-focus restoration and state-2 latch=10 are implemented; highlight reset, FUN_80055068 refresh and FUN_8003B194 behavior remain pending. No whole-block credit for state-only fragments.

functions.name: Validate pair (shared)
functions.pending: Re-order occupied/different-player behavior exists in nba97_reorder_swap; full blocks remain uncredited until shared minimum-size/injury/free-agent branches are reviewed and individually mapped or explicitly excluded from Re-order scope.

functions.name: Swap slots (shared)
functions.pending: Occupied same-team swap and 16-bit counter exist in nba97_reorder_swap; empty-slot search, count changes and compaction remain outside this implemented fragment. No full-function credit.

functions.name: Refresh both lists
functions.pending: Rebind player IDs to row objects, visible-row refresh, selected-player globals and focus restoration.

slices.name: Team normalization and in-memory same-team swap
slices.gate: Fresh core tests plus local database invariants; exact slot order, counts, owners and rejected-input immutability.

slices.name: Two-step selection state machine
slices.gate: Source/destination focus, cancel at each phase, empty/same-player cases and scrolling have exact-state scenarios. CLI/database adapter tested; original visual/input/audio integration remains a separate gate.

slices.name: Original two-list screen and menu entry
slices.gate: Original assets/font/layout and row refresh; menu enters the screen; source-mapped lifecycle and callback dependencies reviewed.

slices.name: Sound, highlights, help and View Player round trips
slices.gate: Recovered sound IDs/timing, focus restoration, original-sized help, player return and exit tested.

slices.name: Local roster persistence and Reset integration
slices.gate: Recover original commit/cancel semantics first; versioned local overrides, atomic save/reload, corrupt-file handling and Reset availability; never overwrite source assets.

slices.name: Original-reference acceptance
slices.gate: Same-scenario original traces and screenshots; every relevant pending block resolved or explicitly justified as outside scope; transitive dependencies audited; known mismatches listed.

dependency_policy: The ten-function denominator is a versioned starting inventory. Calls outside it are listed as dependency addresses, not silently credited or treated as implemented. Discovering additional owners expands the inventory with a documented scope revision. A 100% core percentage alone never opens the feature-completion gate.
